description: This file is a Markdown document describing the 'CompositeInput' HAL interface for managing analog composite video inputs within a platform. It provides detailed overview, architecture, API definitions, capabilities, operation sequence, state machine, and customization instructions, serving as a comprehensive design/specification document.

classes.name: ICompositeInputManager
classes.description: Manager interface for discovering and accessing composite input ports.

classes.name: ICompositeInputPort
classes.description: Per-port interface providing capabilities, status, control, telemetry, and properties.

classes.name: IPortEventListener
classes.description: Callback interface for event notifications such as connection, signal status, and video mode changes.

classes.name: IPortTelemetryListener
classes.description: Callback interface for receiving telemetry and metrics updates.

classes.name: PortCapabilities
classes.description: Capabilities and supported properties/metrics for a specific port.

classes.name: SignalStatus
classes.description: Enumeration for signal states: NO_SIGNAL, UNSTABLE, STABLE, NOT_SUPPORTED.

classes.name: VideoResolution
classes.description: Details about video format, resolution, and interlacing.

classes.name: PortMetrics
classes.description: Telemetry data including lock time, drop counts, uptime.

classes.name: PropertyKVPair
classes.description: Key-value pair used for batch property operations.

classes.name: PropertyMetadata
classes.description: Metadata describing property types, read-only status, and description.

methods.name: getPortIds
methods.description: Obtain list of available port IDs.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Get interface for a specific port ID.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Get capabilities of a port, including supported properties and metrics.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Query a property value by key.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Activate or deactivate this port for video presentation.

methods.name: getSupportedProperties
methods.description: List property keys supported by this port.

methods.name: getSupportedMetrics
methods.description: List metrics supported by this port.

methods.name: getPropertyMetadata
methods.description: Get detailed info about supported properties.
